issue: DistantHorizonsStandalone #62 - Server crashing with the latest alpha16

findings.summary: Server crashes with alpha16 release. Server-side code path differs from client - ForgeServerProxy runs on dedicated server while ForgeClientProxy handles client. Server initialization may have null pointer issues or class loading problems.
findings.root_cause: ForgeServerProxy initialization may fail due to client-only classes being loaded or null checks missing for client-specific dependencies. The ServerLevelWrapper uses ConcurrentHashMap caching without null checks.
evidence: ForgeMain.java:82-86: Server initialization calls onInitializeServer() which may assume client classes available
ForgeServerProxy.java:146-157: serverLevelLoadEvent/unloadEvent cast to WorldServer without instanceof validation
ServerLevelWrapper.java:37: LEVEL_WRAPPER_BY_SERVER_LEVEL ConcurrentHashMap - no null key checks
ForgeServerProxy.java:60: connected static field - potential race condition

primary.issue: Casts to WorldServer without full validation - could fail with modded dimensions
Processes chunk load events without null checking level wrapper

related.note: Cache map operations need null safety review
Server initialization path vs client initialization

gap_analysis.current_behavior: Server-side code assumes WorldServer instances and may fail with null pointers or ClassCastException
gap_analysis.required_behavior: Server code should validate all casts and handle null cases gracefully
gap_analysis.invariant_violated: Server assumes all worlds are WorldServer instances

proposed_fix.approach: Add defensive null checks and instanceof validation in ForgeServerProxy event handlers
implementation_steps: 1. Add null check after GetEventLevel() in serverLevelLoadEvent
2. Validate WorldServer cast with instanceof before casting
3. Add try-catch in serverTickEvent to prevent crash from single bad event
4. Add null check for chunksPendingResetByWorld.get() result
proposed_fix.code_changes: Add defensive programming guards around all event handlers

falsification_test.description: If server still crashes after null checks, issue is deeper in core server API initialization
steps: 1. Add logging at each server event handler entry point
2. Run server and identify which event handler triggers crash
3. Check if crash is in ForgeServerProxy or deeper in ServerApi/Core

confidence_reason: Common pattern in server crashes - lack of defensive programming in event handlers. Without actual crash log, specific line cannot be confirmed.
